findings.title: No price sanity check at intake
findings.screen_workflow: Rapid intake → price
findings.description: Price is whole rupees via int.tryParse with no upper bound, no paise and no confirmation for unusual values; the value goes live as soon as the queue syncs (an extra zero is a 10× price).
findings.reproduction: Enter 15000 instead of 1500 → saved without warning.
findings.root_cause: Minimal validation.
findings.impact: Mispriced garments during a live; the seller can only fix while the piece is still available (update_product).
findings.recommended_remediation: Show the formatted price prominently, warn when > N× drop median, optional quick price chips.
findings.regression_test: Widget test for the warning.

findings.title: No way to hide or delete a mistaken piece
findings.screen_workflow: Seller uploaded the wrong photo or duplicate piece
findings.description: There is no way to hide, archive or delete a piece in the app (the database allows deleting a never-ordered available piece, suite 12.2c). The only way to remove it from the catalogue is the irreversible 'Mark Sold'.
evidence: audit/seller-app/evidence/12_lifecycle_guards.out: INFO 12.2c direct DELETE available product -> OK
findings.reproduction: Try to remove a mistakenly created product.
findings.root_cause: Feature gap.
findings.impact: Wrong items stay visible to buyers or are falsely 'sold', distorting analytics.
findings.recommended_remediation: 'Hide from buyers' / 'Delete draft piece' via an RPC that refuses pieces referenced by orders.
findings.regression_test: SQL + widget test.

findings.title: Registration errors swallowed; slug divergence; placeholder defaults
findings.screen_workflow: Registration
findings.description: The client upsert after sign-up swallows all errors; on a slug collision the trigger appends an id suffix while the client-generated slug differs, so the seller is never told their storefront URL; the trigger fills placeholder phone/UPI/address values if metadata is missing.
findings.reproduction: Register two stores named 'Aarohi Boutique'.
findings.root_cause: Two provisioning paths (trigger + client upsert).
findings.impact: Confusing storefront URL; placeholder payee VPA possible on malformed sign-ups.
findings.recommended_remediation: Single server-side provisioning path; show the final slug; never default a VPA.
findings.regression_test: SQL test for collision path.

findings.title: Pending screen lacks status; Settings hard-codes 'Verified'
findings.screen_workflow: Pending approval screen; Settings → Account
findings.description: The pending screen gives no status, ETA or fee confirmation; Settings always shows 'Verification Status: Active Verified Boutique' regardless of is_approved.
findings.reproduction: Open Settings → Account details.
findings.root_cause: Placeholder text.
findings.impact: Misleading status.
findings.recommended_remediation: Bind to is_approved/application status.
findings.regression_test: Widget test.

findings.title: Seller remarks discarded; RPC parameter name drift
findings.screen_workflow: Payments → Remarks (optional) → Verify
findings.description: Text typed into 'Remarks (optional)' is never sent. The repository's optional override parameter is named p_override_reference while the RPC parameter is p_utr, so any future caller that passes it will fail with a PostgREST 'function not found' error.
findings.reproduction: audit/seller-app/tests/flutter/audit_payment_queue_test.dart (T10).
findings.root_cause: UI field not wired; repository/RPC contract drift.
findings.impact: Seller notes lost (audit trail); latent runtime error.
findings.recommended_remediation: Wire remarks to a notes column (or drop the field); rename the param to p_utr and add a contract test.
findings.regression_test: T10 inverted; repository contract test against the RPC signature.

findings.title: UPI deep link breaks on '#' or '%' in payee name
findings.screen_workflow: Buyer payment intent (seller's display name in pn)
findings.description: The payee name is not fully percent-encoded: '#' and '%' pass through. '#' starts a URI fragment, so am/cu/tr/tn after it are dropped by URI parsers (no pre-filled amount); '%' produces invalid escapes.
findings.reproduction: Suite 13.9 with a store/display name containing '#' or '%'.
findings.root_cause: Hand-rolled encoding that only replaces spaces and '&'.
findings.impact: Buyers type the amount manually → amount mismatches → rejected claims; affects only sellers whose display name contains these characters.
findings.recommended_remediation: Use a complete RFC 3986 encoder for every parameter; restrict display names to safe characters.
findings.regression_test: Suite 13.9 expects %23 and %25.

findings.title: Buyer UTR overwritten without history
findings.screen_workflow: Buyer re-submits a different UTR before verification
findings.description: A second claim with a different UTR overwrites the first; no history of submitted UTRs is kept.
evidence: audit/seller-app/evidence/13_payments.out: INFO 13.12 'stored UTR now=222222222222 (no history of the first UTR)'
findings.reproduction: Suite 13.12.
findings.root_cause: Single mutable column for the claim.
findings.impact: Disputes cannot be reconstructed; a fraudster can swap references after the seller looked at the first one.
findings.recommended_remediation: Append-only claim history (attempt_claims table) and show 'UTR changed' to the seller.
findings.regression_test: Suite 13.12 expects both UTRs recorded.

findings.title: Unclaimed attempts can be verified with an internal reference
findings.screen_workflow: RPC callers (not reachable from the current UI, whose queue only lists claimed attempts)
findings.description: The RPC verifies an attempt the buyer never claimed and records the internal transaction_reference (LD-…-FUL-…) as the ledger reference instead of a bank UTR.
evidence: audit/seller-app/evidence/13_payments.out: INFO 13.11 'verify of unclaimed attempt -> success=true ledger reference=LD-ZP9QE1-FUL-8974'
findings.reproduction: Suite 13.11.
findings.root_cause: No precondition that a buyer reference exists.
findings.impact: Ledger rows without a bank reference cannot be reconciled; a future UI could verify by mistake.
findings.recommended_remediation: Require a claimed state or an explicit seller-entered bank reference (p_utr) for verification.
findings.regression_test: Suite 13.11 expects NO_BUYER_CLAIM unless p_utr is provided.

findings.title: Seven sequential requests on Home
findings.screen_workflow: Home load / pull to refresh
findings.description: The dashboard performs 7 sequential network calls (profile, drops, products, orders, recent activity = claims + orders again, claims again).
findings.reproduction: Count requests on Home load.
findings.root_cause: Sequential awaits and duplicated fetches.
findings.impact: Latency stacks (7 × RTT on 4G).
findings.recommended_remediation: Single summary RPC or Future.wait; reuse fetched data.
findings.regression_test: Request-count test with a fake repository.

findings.title: Cleartext HTTP allowed app-wide
findings.screen_workflow: All network traffic
findings.description: Cleartext HTTP is allowed app-wide and EnvConfig accepts an http:// SUPABASE_URL, so a mis-configured release build would send passwords and JWTs unencrypted.
findings.reproduction: Build with --dart-define=SUPABASE_URL=http://... — the app starts and logs in over HTTP.
findings.root_cause: Debug convenience left in release configuration.
findings.impact: Credential/token exposure on hostile Wi-Fi if misconfigured; Play pre-launch warnings.
findings.recommended_remediation: Remove usesCleartextTraffic (or restrict via network_security_config to 10.0.2.2/localhost for debug); reject http:// in release builds.
findings.regression_test: Unit test: EnvConfig.validate() throws for http:// when kReleaseMode.

findings.title: Session refresh token included in Android backups
findings.component: Android backup configuration (no allowBackup/dataExtractionRules) + supabase_flutter default session persistence (seller-app/lib/core/services/supabase_service.dart:38-40)
findings.screen_workflow: Session persistence
findings.description: The refresh token is persisted by supabase_flutter's default SharedPreferences storage and Android backup is not disabled, so the session can be included in device backups.
findings.reproduction: adb backup / Auto Backup on a test device, restore on another device, launch the app → session may be restored (device test required).
findings.root_cause: Template defaults.
findings.impact: Seller session portable through backups; low likelihood, high consequence (payments, buyer PII).
findings.recommended_remediation: android:allowBackup="false" or dataExtractionRules excluding shared_prefs; optionally a flutter_secure_storage-backed LocalStorage.
findings.regression_test: Manifest lint check in CI.

findings.title: anon can EXECUTE more functions than buyers need
findings.screen_workflow: PostgREST RPC surface
findings.description: anon can execute is_seller_approved(uuid) (approval-status oracle), update_product and mark_order_ready_to_ship (both reject internally), generate_upi_payment_uri and trigger functions. No exploit was found, but the surface exceeds what buyers need.
evidence: audit/seller-app/evidence/security-definer-search-path.out (all 20 SECURITY DEFINER functions pin search_path — PASS)
findings.reproduction: SELECT proname FROM pg_proc ... has_function_privilege('anon', oid, 'EXECUTE') (see 90_hosted_readonly_checks.sql H5).
findings.root_cause: Default privileges grant EXECUTE to anon; only some functions were explicitly revoked.
findings.impact: Defense-in-depth gap; any future bug in those functions becomes anonymously reachable.
findings.recommended_remediation: REVOKE EXECUTE ... FROM anon (and PUBLIC) on seller/admin functions; ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTIONS FROM anon; CI allow-list test.
findings.regression_test: Catalog test comparing anon-executable functions to an allow-list.

findings.title: Courier default/free text; no tracking URL
findings.screen_workflow: Dispatch dialog
findings.description: Courier defaults to 'Delhivery Express' and is free text in one screen, a fixed list in another; no tracking URL is generated for the buyer.
findings.reproduction: Open Dispatch on two different screens.
findings.root_cause: Two independent implementations.
findings.impact: Wrong courier recorded when not changed; inconsistent data for buyers.
findings.recommended_remediation: Single courier picker (remember last used) with tracking URL templates.
findings.regression_test: Widget test.

findings.title: Low-contrast muted text; minimal screen-reader support
findings.screen_workflow: Timestamps, hints, secondary labels, nav labels
findings.description: textMuted on obsidian/obsidianSurface has ≈3.8:1 contrast, below WCAG AA 4.5:1 for normal text; it is used for nav labels (11 px) and timestamps. Screen-reader support is minimal: 6 tooltips in the whole app, no Semantics labels on icon-only controls, fixed 11-13 px text not checked against large system font sizes.
findings.reproduction: Contrast checker.
findings.root_cause: Aesthetic choice.
findings.impact: Hard to read outdoors/in bright studio light.
findings.recommended_remediation: Raise to ≥60% white (≈6:1) for text; keep 40% for decoration only.
findings.regression_test: Token contrast unit test.

findings.title: Raw exception text shown to sellers
findings.screen_workflow: Error feedback
findings.description: Raw exception strings reach sellers ('Verification failed: LiveDropException…', 'Error: $e', 'Print spooler error: $e', raw 23514 constraint text).
findings.reproduction: Trigger any server rejection.
findings.root_cause: No error-to-message mapping.
findings.impact: Seller cannot act on the message.
findings.recommended_remediation: Map error codes to plain, actionable text (Hindi/English later).
findings.regression_test: Unit test of the mapping.

findings.title: 'Remember me' does nothing
findings.screen_workflow: Login
findings.description: 'Remember me' is displayed but has no effect; sessions always persist.
findings.reproduction: Untick, log in, kill and reopen the app → still logged in.
findings.root_cause: Placeholder control.
findings.impact: False expectation on shared phones.
findings.recommended_remediation: Remove it or implement (non-persistent session).
findings.regression_test: Widget test.

findings.title: Dead/placeholder code; missing mounted checks
findings.screen_workflow: n/a
findings.description: getOrders(dropId) is unused and selects fewer columns than the model expects; markOrderPaid is a throwing stub; Kanban builds a placeholder profile ('+91 9999999999', 'store@upi'); _soundEnabled is unused; product_details_screen.dart:263 calls setState after an await without a mounted check.
findings.reproduction: grep.
findings.root_cause: Iterative prototyping.
findings.impact: Maintenance risk; placeholder data could leak into labels/messages if a future refactor reaches that path.
findings.recommended_remediation: Delete dead code; fail loudly when the profile is missing.
findings.regression_test: analyzer + coverage.

findings.title: Admin UPI/WhatsApp/fee compiled into the app
findings.screen_workflow: Registration fee / support contact
findings.description: Admin WhatsApp number, admin UPI ID/name (overridable only at build time via --dart-define) and the ₹50 fee (a plain constant) are compiled into the app; changing them requires a new APK.
findings.reproduction: n/a.
findings.root_cause: Static config.
findings.impact: Operational inflexibility; stale numbers in old installs.
findings.recommended_remediation: Serve from a platform_settings table.
findings.regression_test: n/a.

findings.title: Codes rendered with a double hash (##A01)
findings.screen_workflow: Intake bottom sheet and snackbars
findings.description: The code already contains '#', and the UI prefixes another one: header and snackbars read '##A01' / '(##A02 ready)'.
findings.reproduction: Open intake and capture a photo.
findings.root_cause: Formatting duplication.
findings.impact: Cosmetic, but confuses the code the seller reads aloud on stream.
findings.recommended_remediation: Render the code as stored.
findings.regression_test: Widget test for header text.
